question: Where is the nearest hotel you pass when going from Barons Bus Arena, Parma, OH to Wellington Reservation, Wellington, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Barons Bus Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Parma%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( -- Wellington Reservation is likely a park, which does not have address columns. -- Filter by intersecting with the Wellington city region. SELECT p.geometry FROM parks p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Wellington Reservation%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Wellington%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, end_point ep WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' -- Find hotels within 1000 meters (1km) of the direct line between the start and end points AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)::geography, 1000 ) ORDER BY -- Order by distance from the starting point to simulate "passing when going from A to B" ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
